description:
Cut v1.1.0 (minor — backward-compatible Gemini provider; codex stays the default). Steps: bump package.json version 1.0.0→1.1.0; commit ("1.1.0" or "chore: bump version to 1.1.0"); tag annotated `git tag -a v1.1.0 -m "v1.1.0"` (matches the v0.x convention; v1.0.0 was lightweight); push; `npm publish`.

Verified this session: package is unscoped (npm publish defaults to public); prepublishOnly runs build+typecheck+lint+test; npm auth ok (logged in as owner `ashayegh`); no test asserts a literal version (server.test.ts reads it dynamically from package.json, asserts != 0.1.4); server + CLI read version from package.json at runtime so bumping is sufficient. Caveat: npm 2FA may prompt for an OTP at publish (`npm publish --otp=<code>`).

Blocked by T-021 — the README/package.json multi-provider docs should land before publish so 1.1.0 ships with accurate docs.
title: Cut and publish v1.1.0
